youtube.description:
A 50-year-old founder is 2.8 times more likely to build a top-performing company than a 25-year-old. That's peer-reviewed data from MIT and Harvard.

In this video, Brian McKinney breaks down exactly how to start an online business after 50 — the tools, the mindset, and the step-by-step first week plan.

78,557 tech workers were laid off in Q1 2026. Nearly half because of AI. The companies are not waiting. Neither should you.

52.3% of U.S. businesses are owned by people 55 and older.

Free course — Lesson 1 AI Foundations: learnmoretechnologies.com/join-now
Free strategy session: calendly.com/brianmckinney/new-meeting

Brian McKinney | Founder, Learn More Technologies & 50+TechBridge | MBE Certified
